title: The four-day week works. It's time to make it law
purpose: Procédés classiques en anglais ; une allégation fausse et une exacte.

expected.quote: My cousin's startup switched to a four-day week last spring and doubled its revenue within six months. That is proof that it works for every kind of business.
Experts agree that productivity always rises when working hours fall.
As a famous actor put it in a recent interview, "nobody needs a fifth day of work."
Either we adopt the four-day week, or we accept burnout as the price of having a job.
the United States has had a legal 32-hour work week since 1938
expected.note: Faux : le Fair Labor Standards Act de 1938 fixe 44 h, puis 42 h en octobre 1939 et 40 h en octobre 1940.

expected.quote: Between 2015 and 2019, Iceland ran trials of shorter working hours involving about 2,500 public sector workers.
expected.note: Exact : essais d'Alda et Autonomy, environ 1 % de la population active.
